title: Fix Mcp App Black Screen Use Compose Ui
description: The start_working_in_local_kit MCP tool shows a black screen instead of the Kit UI from compose/ui. The compose engine MCP must use compose/ui exclusively.
summary: start_working_in_local_kit (and start_new_kit, start_working_in_remote_kit) now declare ui://compose/kit-viewer so hosts load the kit shell, not the design viewer. Added McpKitViewer + mountMcpKitViewer in compose/ui using ComposeKit; mcp-app.tsx branches on #root data-mcp-viewer. Registered MCP resource kit_viewer_resource and REST GET /app/kit-viewer; _build_kit_viewer_html reuses the single-file bundle with data-mcp-viewer=kit. Engine tests: kit vs design tool meta + kit endpoint. 166 engine tests pass.
